title: oauth2token sink
description: Fetches an OAuth2 access token from a token endpoint and keeps it in tenant variables, renewing it when it expires within expiryDelay. Every message that reaches the step triggers the check (put a repeater in front); the message is not used. The token is set in each variable of tokenName and in the same name with the suffix _Temp. Unlike the Java platform, DIF takes the endpoint and credentials from these options and the environment, not from a tenant configuration.

path.title: Id
path.description: From the URI: oauth2token:<id>; not used

tokenName.title: Token variables
tokenName.description: Tenant variables to set to the token, separated by commas

expiryDelay.title: Expiry delay
expiryDelay.description: Seconds before the token expires at which it is renewed

tokenUrl.title: Token endpoint
tokenUrl.description: https URL of the token endpoint (http only for localhost); required to create the step

grantType.title: Grant type
grantType.description: client_credentials needs clientSecret; refresh_token needs refreshToken

clientId.title: Client id
clientId.description: OAuth2 client id; required to create the step

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret; env DIF_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET (or its _FILE companion)

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Refresh token for the refresh_token grant; env DIF_OAUTH2_REFRESH_TOKEN (or its _FILE companion)

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Requested scopes, separated by spaces; "" for the server's default

clientAuthentication.title: Client authentication
clientAuthentication.description: basic: client id and secret by HTTP Basic; post: in the request body

trustStoreFile.title: Trust store
trustStoreFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the certificates to trust; "" trusts the system's roots

trustStorePassword.title: Trust store password
trustStorePassword.description: Trust store password; env DIF_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds the whole call may take
